title: Concrete quotient chain maps with tensor formulas
statement: Fix the prime, finite coefficient extension, completed ring sheaf and finite coefficient levels on a scheme W as in [lem-coef-compact-support-quotient-coordinates]. For n <= m and every complex P of completed coefficient modules, there exist ordinary quotient and balancing chain maps a:P_m -> Res(P_n) and b:Lq(P_m) -> P_n, with b invertible. On sections a(s tensor x)=q(s) tensor x and b(t tensor(s tensor x))=(t q(s)) tensor x. The functors and tensor sections are the actual published coefficient constructions. No derived square, component-object identification or flatness assertion is included.

proof.text: Take a and b termwise from the named natural quotient transformation and balancing isomorphism. Naturality gives the chain-map differential equations. Apply their two component formulas and use componentwise isomorphism of b to obtain an isomorphism of complexes.

theorem compactSupportQuotient_chain_formulas (W : Scheme.{u})
    (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W) ℤ) :
    ∃ (a : (compactSupportQuotientComplex l E W m).obj P ⟶
        ((proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars W
          (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((compactSupportQuotientComplex l E W n).obj P))
      (b : ((pbcExtend.{u} (compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E W m n h)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj ((compactSupportQuotientComplex l E W m).obj P) ⟶
        (compactSupportQuotientComplex l E W n).obj P),
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf.{u, u} l E W m).obj.obj U)
        (x : (P.X i).val.obj U),
        HEq ((a.f i).val.app U (compactSupportQuotientTensor l E W m (P.X i) U s x))
          (compactSupportQuotientTensor l E W n (P.X i) U
            ((compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E W m n h).hom.app U s) x)) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf.{u, u} l E W m).obj.obj U)
        (t : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf.{u, u} l E W n).obj.obj U)
        (x : (P.X i).val.obj U),
        (b.f i).val.app U
          (pbcTensorSection (compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E W m n h)
            ((scalarReductionExtension.{u, u} l E W m).obj (P.X i)) U t
              (compactSupportQuotientTensor l E W m (P.X i) U s x)) =
          compactSupportQuotientTensor l E W n (P.X i) U
            (t * (compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E W m n h).hom.app U s) x) ∧
      IsIso b
